subject: Class and category of data items and literals
notes: kb/Work PB1398 landed (wave 1004 D). A boolean function result is the data item of category boolean with an implicit usage bit (cite.py --check 8.5.2.5 'an item is referred to as a boolean' OK; 15.2 item 2), admitted by 15.50.3 r1 / 15.14.3 r1 through 8.4.3.2.1. LENGTH counts boolean positions (15.50.4 r1): BOOLEAN-OF-INTEGER(5, 16) is 16. BYTE-LENGTH packs 8 positions to the byte and rounds up (15.14.4 r4): 16 -> 2, 9 -> 2, 8 -> 1 (IntrinsicRenderer ByteLength arm over CobolIntrinsics.ByteLengthBoolean).
